text_block_list.text:
This is the classic year. I'm hoping I can 
get even more out of Gold Ship…!

I was about to speak to her about that 
when wishing her a happy new year but…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ― Happy new year, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The year has turned over… and with it, I 
have been reborn out of my past self.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But you know what, I think this is a 
miracle. If there was no earth, no 
universe…… I wouldn't exist here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to make this year a year to 
be thankful for everything.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thank you earth, thank you universe. And 
thank you standing in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now, please listen; "Happy New Year ～From 
frigid winter into a new spring～"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: … Thanks so much for listening

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
… Hmm? What is it? You got something to 
tell me too?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No prob. Come out with it. Send that fiery 
pathos straight at me!
choice_data_list:
Let's get some results in the Classics 
this year!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: … What now? Classics?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I was planning on showing off my mad 
guitar skills this year―

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But in this day and age, violin might be 
not be a bad choice either.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sounds cool! Tell me more! How do you want 
me to play? Huh!?

I don't think we're on the same page here, 
but anyway―
choice_data_list:
You should build the strength for long 
events!
We'll figure it out together later.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I see. You mean I'll need stamina to keep 
up long concerts.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That classic stuff has music over 10 hours 
long after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heck yeah…!! 10 hours, 20 hours, it don't 
matter to me, I'll play the whole dang 
thing, no break!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho hoh, you wanna respect the band 
members's opinions huh? That's great.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bands often break up because of musical 
differences, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's talk the talk out of it…! 
Come at me! I'll let this fist do the 
talking!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hey… Did you just say… dome tour!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dream big, is that it! ! Oof, the passion… 
it's burning me!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hooyeah!! Time for a jam session, right 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We ain't doing this without aiming for the 
top!!!!
